filters.wordsModeHint: Whole word avoids blocking harmless messages (for example, "class" for containing "ass"). Partial blocks any message that contains the fragment.

request.title: Request a character voice
request.intro: Search for the voice, listen to the sample and request the one you like, so you know how it sounds before asking. We review it and, if approved, it appears in the list for everyone. With the Patrocinador rank you can add your own voices without waiting.
request.notFound: Can't find it? Describe it in your own words
request.textPlaceholder: E.g.: Goku's voice in Latin American Spanish
request.sent: Request sent. We'll review it soon.
request.sendError: The request could not be sent
request.playError: The browser could not play the audio

commandVoice.needCredits: Premium and character voices need voice credits.
commandVoice.noBalanceSilence: It stays silent and the bot warns in chat
